advisory_exceptions.name: ttf-parser
advisory_exceptions.reason: Temporary maintenance exception for Wayland titlebar font parsing; replacing the CSD text stack needs Linux titlebar tests and native dependency review.
advisory_exceptions.exposure_review: Runtime system-font bytes selected by fc-match are memory-mapped and parsed by sctk-adwaita AbGlyphTitleText; embedded Cantarell is fallback. This is not compile-only. No photo-import parser exposure is claimed; malicious or corrupt installed font data remains an exposure.
advisory_exceptions.removal_condition: Replace or upgrade the Wayland titlebar parser stack without dropping titlebars; validate Linux system-font selection and fallback.

advisory_exceptions.name: zvariant
advisory_exceptions.reason: Temporary maintenance exception for the zbus 5 accessibility/settings stack; zbus 6 migration requires coordinated Slint and AT-SPI API changes.
advisory_exceptions.exposure_review: Runtime D-Bus message and variant decoding for desktop accessibility/settings; local session-bus peers can supply data. Preserve existing accessibility and settings behavior; no compile-only claim.
advisory_exceptions.removal_condition: Migrate Slint, accesskit_unix, atspi, atspi-common and atspi-proxies together to zbus 6; validate native accessibility/settings.

advisory_exceptions.name: zbus_names
advisory_exceptions.reason: Temporary maintenance exception for zbus 5 name types required by the current accessibility/settings APIs; coordinated zbus 6 migration remains open.
advisory_exceptions.exposure_review: Runtime D-Bus names from accessibility/settings session-bus traffic are parsed/validated; local peers can supply input. Disabling accessibility to hide this dependency is not accepted.
advisory_exceptions.removal_condition: Migrate the coordinated zbus/AT-SPI name-type APIs and validate desktop settings and accessibility.

advisory_exceptions.name: zvariant_derive
advisory_exceptions.reason: Temporary maintenance exception for code generation paired with zvariant 5; upgrading it independently would break generated wire-type implementations.
advisory_exceptions.exposure_review: Host proc macro generates variant serialization/deserialization implementations used by runtime D-Bus accessibility/settings. The macro itself handles Rust syntax, while generated code handles session-bus input.
advisory_exceptions.removal_condition: Migrate with zvariant and zbus 6; validate generated wire contracts and native accessibility/settings.

advisory_exceptions.name: chrono
advisory_exceptions.reason: Temporary maintenance-only exception for Slint 1.19 date/calendar APIs and exact dormant Turso metadata paths; replacement must preserve date/text/calendar/local-time and SQL timestamp behavior.
advisory_exceptions.exposure_review: Active i-slint-core date_time.rs parses UI date/format strings, computes calendar month/weekday values, formats dates and reads Local::now plus system clock/timezone. Full metadata also includes dormant Turso_core/ext paths: SQL timestamp/date/RFC3339 parsing and arithmetic, timezone conversion, clock/pragma date values and VFS current-time formatting. Runtime text/database/OS-time inputs are reviewed; these uses are not compile-only or image/RAW decoding. Current normal cargo tree reaches Chrono through Slint only.
advisory_exceptions.removal_condition: Adopt maintained date/time implementations through compatible upstream releases or a separately reviewed migration; validate parsing/formatting, invalid inputs, calendar/local-time boundaries and any activated SQL timestamp paths before removing this review.

advisory_review.classification: Maintenance notice; no security vulnerability classification is downgraded.
